subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's sister's daughter is my ___.
explain: Children of mother's siblings are maternal cousins.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's only brother's only sister is my ___.
explain: Mother's only brother's only sister is mother herself.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's mother's sister is my ___.
explain: Mother's mother's sister is the maternal grandmother's sister: maternal grandaunt.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My father's mother's husband is my ___.
explain: Father's mother's husband is the father's father, the paternal grandfather.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My father's mother's only daughter's son is my ___.
explain: Father's only sister's son is a paternal cousin.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: B is the sister of C. What can be said about C's gender?
explain: 'Sister of C' fixes B (female), but C may be a brother or a sister.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Which of these relation terms is gender-definite (male)?
explain: Son-in-law is always male; the other three can be male or female.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: M is the sibling of N's son. What can be said about M's gender?
explain: A sibling of N's son may be N's son or daughter, so gender is open.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is the father of B's cousin. What is A's gender?
explain: 'Father' is male-definite; B's own gender does not matter.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Which pair of relation terms are both gender-neutral?
explain: Cousin and sibling can be male or female; the other pairs fix gender.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: In a family tree, '+' denotes male and '−' denotes female. Symbols placed on the same horizontal level are in which relation?
explain: Each horizontal level of a tree represents one generation; the vertical position shows generation.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Tree: A(+) = B(−); their daughter is C(−), and C's son is D(+). How is D related to A?
explain: A is C's father, so D, C's son, is A's daughter's son, i.e. grandson (maternal).
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is B's twin. What can be said about A's gender?
explain: 'Twin' is gender-neutral; twins can be of the same or opposite gender.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Which statement about P definitely fixes P's gender?
explain: 'Brother' is male-definite; the other terms are gender-neutral.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is the wife of B's father's only son. What can be said about B's gender?
explain: B may be that only son (male) or his sister (female).
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is the sibling of B's mother's husband. What is A's gender?
explain: A is B's uncle or aunt; 'sibling' gives no gender.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is B's spouse's sibling. What can be said about A's gender?
explain: A may be a brother-in-law or sister-in-law; 'sibling' is neutral.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: In a tree, P(−) = Q(+) are a couple. Their daughter R(−) has a brother S(+). How is S related to P?
explain: S is a child of couple P and Q, so S is P's son.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Tree: A(+) = B(−); their son C(+) = D(−) have a daughter E(−). How is E related to B?
explain: E is a child of B's son C, so E is B's granddaughter.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Which pair of relation terms are BOTH gender-definite (female)?
explain: Aunt and niece are female. Cousin, sibling and spouse are gender-neutral.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is B's father's sister's only brother. What is A's gender?
explain: 'Brother' fixes A as male, even if A turns out to be B's father.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Your father's mother's sister is your:
explain: A grandparent's sister is a grandaunt (great-aunt).
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Your mother's second husband, who is not your father, is your:
explain: A mother's later husband who is not one's biological father is a stepfather.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Your brother's son's son is your:
explain: A nephew's son is one's grandnephew (one generation below a nephew).
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Your spouse's parents and siblings are collectively called your:
explain: Relatives gained through marriage are in-laws.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Your wife's sister is your:
explain: A spouse's sister is a sister-in-law.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My father's father's father is my ___.
explain: Three steps up the father's line gives the paternal great-grandfather.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My father's mother's brother is my father's ___.
explain: A mother's brother is a maternal uncle, here of my father.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's only sister's only brother is my ___.
explain: He is also my mother's only brother, so my maternal uncle.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My paternal uncle's wife's father-in-law is my ___.
explain: Her father-in-law is my uncle's father, my father's father.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My father's only brother's only sister is my ___.
explain: She is also my father's only sister, so my paternal aunt.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's father's father is my ___.
explain: Two steps up the mother's line from my mother is her grandfather's side: the maternal great-grandfather.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: My mother's father's wife's only son's wife is my ___.
explain: Maternal grandmother's only son is my maternal uncle; his wife is my maternal aunt.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A man says, "My father's only son's only son is my ___."
explain: Father's only son = himself, so his only son is his own son.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A woman says, "My mother's only son's wife is my ___."
explain: Mother's only son is her brother (not herself), so his wife is her sister-in-law.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A man says, "My father's only son's father-in-law is my ___."
explain: Father's only son = self; self's father-in-law is his own father-in-law.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: Pointing to a girl, a man says, "Her mother is my father's only son's wife." The girl is his ___.
explain: Father's only son = self, so his wife is the girl's mother; the girl is his daughter.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A man says, "My father's only son's wife's only brother is my ___."
explain: Father's only son = self; his wife's brother is his brother-in-law.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is the brother of B's husband. What is B's gender?
explain: B has a husband, so B is a wife, i.e. female. A is male.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is B's mother's brother's wife. What is A's gender?
explain: A is a wife (maternal aunt by marriage), so female.
subject: Logical Reasoning

prompt: A is the parent of B's mother's only child. What can be said about A's gender?
explain: B's mother's only child is B, so A is B's parent: father or mother.
subject: Logical Reasoning
